header: Wave Race 64's shader plan for N64Recomp-browser's tools/record_shaders.mjs (tools/record_shaders.sh runs it):
Start Game, then the menus as a player reaches them (keys held 150 ms, pressed until the game's state
(gGameState, 0x800DAB24) says the next screen is up: Start is Enter, A is X, the stick the arrows), the attract
demo, then each course in Time Trials, reached by putting its place in the course select list in the cursor
(0x800DA9D0) before A, and raced 50 s with the gas held, steered by tools/autopilot.js for the next buoy, the
countdown that retires a rider who has left the course (standing +0x2E8, 0x801C2938 + 0x378 a rider) kept from
running out; then a Championship race on Sunny Beach with its three other riders, and in a load of its own a Normal
Championship's first three races (Sunny Beach, Sunset Bay, Marine Fortress), each raced 30 s and then ended by
putting the rider on its last lap with every buoy taken and finished (standing +0x0, +0xC and +0x2F4), through each
finish and results to the screens a championship ends with when the rider doesn't qualify for the next race; and
Stunt Mode. 2P VS isn't played: it needs a second pad.

sections.name: dolphin
steps: (clearInterval(window.noRetire), window.noRetire = setInterval(() => { for (let s = 0; s < 4; s++) { const a = 0x801C2938 + s * 0x378 + 0x2E8, v = n64r(a); if (v > 0 && v < 40) n64w(a, 59); } }, 1), 0)
